registration.scope: One combined lexical focus/packing refinement, following source/category/family metadata qualification. Original diagnostic labels and v1 outcomes remain intact.
registration.order: Alternate v1/v2 order by task index plus repetition index. Both warm, same retained root/view. Tokenizer initialized before timings.
registration.required_control: Every v1 response and metric must reproduce the retained v1 study exactly before measuring.
registration.acceptance: Retain v2 if any-span hit count and mean labeled-span recall do not decline, pooled descriptive warm p95 decreases, and all budgets/provenance are valid. Report all individual losses. No parameter retuning after outcomes.
